summary:
If x is a float, returns the equivalent int value, discarding any fractional part by truncating toward zero.

If x is a buffer, returns the integer embedded in the buffer in network byte order.

If x is a string, attempts to convert it to an integer by reading the numeric prefix from the first character until a non-numeric portion is encountered. If conversion fails, returns UNDEFINED (whose value is 0).
details:
Example
to_int(3.14) == 3
to_int(3.89) == 3
to_int("3.14") == 3
to_int("3.14abc") == 3
to_int("abc3.14") == UNDEFINED
